title: Project overview
next_event: Next listed show or storm forecast
no_next_event: No listed show or storm forecast (n=0)
storm_source: MET forecast source (opens in a new tab)
first_run_next_ask: Next, ask for a call: Skyclause drafts a bundle for an approver to review.
first_run_next_declare: Next, declare the windows you want a call for.
ask_call_done: Asked. The bundle shows here once it is drafted.
ask_call_failed: Couldn’t ask for a call just now.
ask_call_confirm_body: Skyclause drafts a bundle for the approver to review.
ask_call_drafted: Drafted. The new bundle is in the list below.
ask_call_no_draft: No bundle was drafted. Check the pack's sources, then ask again.
ask_call_run_failed: The run failed, so no bundle was drafted. Ask again.
ask_call_still_drafting: Still drafting. Reload the page in a few minutes to see the bundle.
ask_call_unavailable: Asking for a call is not available yet.
ask_call_budget: No more calls can be asked for today. Asking opens again at {time}.
ask_call_budget_no_time: No more calls can be asked for today.
ask_call_rate_limited: Too many asks just now. Try again in a minute.
ask_call_forbidden: Your role can’t ask for a call in this project.
ask_call_pack_off: The Sky pack is off for this project. Turn it on in Packs and sources.
ask_call_archived: This project is archived, so no call can be asked for.
ask_call_suspended: This project is suspended, so no call can be asked for.
replay: Replay of {source}, captured {captured}: the input ages come from it.
